statement: Either side offers its own funds for the other's: `offer` names a maker, a give leg and a want leg in two different tokens (same_token), amounts in 1..MAX_AMOUNT, a slot of its own (offer_exists) and a deadline in range (N2). The maker's give is reserved against the maker in its token and the taker's want against the taker in the other, each only if its RCPAN still holds, so a fill can never fail on funds. An offer is one clause against R-HOLD-CAP together with the holds, across tokens. The Arrival cell holds the reservations (the maker's give in its token and the taker's want in the other, always exactly what the open offers could still take) and the RCPAN check: an offer is kept only if RCPAN holds with its reservations, and in the worst case over the open offers a fill never fails on funds; the fault names (same_token, offer_exists, the deadline range, the amount bounds) and the R-HOLD-CAP count are on no page (one offer per slot, one token pair).
source: Arthur 10-01 02:53 (D3: two-party swap inside an Account); plan/swap-onchain.md; coordinator 10-01
